anomalies.description: Two men engage in a close-quarters martial arts combat sequence: one in grey initiates with punches and blocks, while the other in white gi with black belt counters with high kicks, strikes, and grappling; the exchange includes rapid hand-to-hand contact, evasive maneuvers, and culminates in a takedown or clinch at the end of the sequence.

Two men in white martial arts uniforms engage in a choreographed hand-to-hand combat sequence, involving blocks, strikes, and evasive maneuvers, culminating in one man executing a high kick that sends the other airborne.

After being struck and thrown, the defeated man lies motionless on the floor while multiple others in uniform kneel beside him, appearing to restrain or subdue him; his posture and lack of resistance suggest helplessness, consistent with abuse in a martial arts training context.
